      - .github/workflows/approve-by-default-smoke.yml
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: write-all

concurrency:
  group: approve-by-default-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    env:

        run: node --test test/feature-flags-default-policy.test.js

name: Encrypted Backup Restore Drill

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 4 1 * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: write-all

concurrency:
  group: cyvx-backup-restore-drill
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  restore-latest-production-backup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      CYVX_ENV: production
      CYVX_BACKUP_STORAGE_URL: ${{ secrets.CYVX_BACKUP_STORAGE_URL }}
      CYVX_BACKUP_STORAGE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CYVX_BACKUP_STORAGE_TOKEN }}
      CYVX_BACKUP_BUCKET: ${{ secrets.CYVX_BACKUP_BUCKET }}
      CYVX_BACKUP_PREFIX: production
      CYVX_BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY: ${{ secrets.CYVX_BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Validate required recovery secrets
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          for name in CYVX_BACKUP_STORAGE_URL CYVX_BACKUP_STORAGE_TOKEN CYVX_BACKUP_BUCKET CYVX_BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY; do
            if [ -z "${!name:-}" ]; then
              echo "::error::$name is required for the restore drill"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
      - name: Download, authenticate, decrypt, and restore latest backup
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          rm -rf /tmp/cyvx-production-restore-drill
          node ./scripts/restore-v7.js \
            --latest \
            --target /tmp/cyvx-production-restore-drill \
            --force | tee /tmp/cyvx-restore-drill.json
          test -s /tmp/cyvx-restore-drill.json
          test "$(find /tmp/cyvx-production-restore-drill -type f | wc -l)" -gt 0
      - name: Run local cryptographic recovery regression
        run: node ./scripts/backup-v7.js --self-test | tee /tmp/cyvx-local-recovery-proof.json
      - name: Retain recovery evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cyvx-backup-restore-drill-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            /tmp/cyvx-restore-drill.json
            /tmp/cyvx-local-recovery-proof.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 90
      - name: Destroy restored production data
        if: always()
        run: rm -rf /tmp/cyvx-production-restore-drill /tmp/*.cyvxbak

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: write-all

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  production-baseline:
    name: Authoritative runtime gate and compatibility regression
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    env:
      NODE_ENV: test
      CYVX_ENV: test
      CYVX_ALLOW_INSECURE_LOCAL: "true"
      CYVX_AUTH_SECRET: "ci-runtime-secret-longer-than-thirty-two-characters"
      CYVX_DATA_ROOT: /tmp/cyvx-ci
      SPARK_ARTIFACT_ROOT: /tmp/cyvx-ci/worlds
      SPARK_STATE_FILE: /tmp/cyvx-ci/spark-state.json
      CYVX_PLATFORM_STATE: /tmp/cyvx-ci/platform-state.json
      CYVX_LOG_PATH: /tmp/cyvx-ci/logs/runtime.jsonl
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Execute authoritative production gate
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          bash scripts/verify.sh 2>&1 | tee /tmp/cyvx-production-verification.log

      - name: Verify legacy API compatibility
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          rm -rf "$CYVX_DATA_ROOT"
          mkdir -p "$CYVX_DATA_ROOT"
          PORT=3000 node ./api/index.js > /tmp/cyvx-api.log 2>&1 &
          API_PID=$!
          cleanup() { kill "$API_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; }
          trap cleanup EXIT
          for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/healthz >/dev/null; then
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/healthz
          curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/status
          curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/overview
          curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/insights

      - name: Verify standalone Spark compatibility
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          SPARK_PORT=3100 node ./spark/server.js > /tmp/spark.log 2>&1 &
          SPARK_PID=$!
          cleanup() { kill "$SPARK_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; }
          trap cleanup EXIT
          for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3100/healthz >/dev/null; then
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          BASE=http://127.0.0.1:3100
          CREATED="$(curl -fsS -X POST "$BASE/api/v1/sparks" \
            -H 'content-type: application/json' \
            -H 'idempotency-key: ci-compat-spark' \
            -d '{"owner_id":"ci-founder","intention":"Launch a compatibility World","world":{"name":"CI Compatibility World"}}')"
          SPARK_ID="$(printf '%s' "$CREATED" | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8")).data.spark.id')"
          WORLD_ID="$(printf '%s' "$CREATED" | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8")).data.world.id')"
          curl -fsS -X POST "$BASE/api/v1/sparks/$SPARK_ID/approval" \
            -H 'content-type: application/json' \
            -d '{"owner_id":"ci-founder","decision":"approved"}' >/dev/null
          EXECUTED="$(curl -fsS -X POST "$BASE/api/v1/sparks/$SPARK_ID/execute" \
            -H 'content-type: application/json' \
            -d '{"owner_id":"ci-founder"}')"
          printf '%s' "$EXECUTED" | node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(0,"utf8"));if(x.data.world.status!=="operational")process.exit(1)'
          curl -fsS -X POST "$BASE/api/v1/worlds/$WORLD_ID/leads" \
            -H 'content-type: application/json' \
            -H 'idempotency-key: ci-compat-lead' \
            -d '{"name":"CI Lead","email":"ci@example.com"}' >/dev/null
          curl -fsS "$BASE/metrics" | grep 'spark_leads_total 1'

      - name: Upload verification and diagnostic artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cyvx-ci-verification
          path: |
            artifacts/verification-report.json
            artifacts/verification-logs/*.log
            docs/PRODUCTION_STATUS.md
            /tmp/cyvx-production-verification.log
            /tmp/cyvx-api.log
            /tmp/spark.log
            /tmp/cyvx-ci/logs/*.jsonl*
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14

name: Cloudflare Edge Baseline

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: Protected GitHub environment containing Cloudflare credentials
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: staging
        options: [staging, production]
      apply:
        description: Apply the CYVX rules instead of generating a redacted plan
        type: boolean
        required: true
        default: false

permissions: write-all

concurrency:
  group: cyvx-cloudflare-${{ inputs.environment }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  provision:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    environment: ${{ inputs.environment }}
    env:
      CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
      CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID }}
      CYVX_EDGE_ORIGIN_SECRET: ${{ secrets.CYVX_EDGE_ORIGIN_SECRET }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Validate edge secret
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          test "${#CYVX_EDGE_ORIGIN_SECRET}" -ge 32
          if [ "${{ inputs.apply }}" = "true" ]; then
            test -n "$CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
            test -n "$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID"
          fi
      - name: Generate redacted edge plan
        run: node ./scripts/provision-cloudflare-v8.js | tee /tmp/cyvx-cloudflare-plan.json
      - name: Apply managed CYVX edge rules
        if: inputs.apply
        run: node ./scripts/provision-cloudflare-v8.js --apply | tee /tmp/cyvx-cloudflare-apply.json
      - name: Retain edge evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cyvx-cloudflare-${{ inputs.environment }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            /tmp/cyvx-cloudflare-plan.json
            /tmp/cyvx-cloudflare-apply.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 90

concurrency:

  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Entity, demand, CRM, payment, fulfillment, evidence, and HTTP verification
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      NODE_ENV: test
      CYVX_ALLOW_INSECURE_LOCAL: "true"
      CYVX_AUTH_SECRET: "operator-ci-secret-longer-than-thirty-two-characters"
      CYVX_DATA_ROOT: /tmp/cyvx-universal-revenue-ci
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Validate public and production source modules
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          node ./scripts/check-v7.js 2>&1 | tee /tmp/v7-source-validation.log

      - name: Verify universal, venture, and real revenue lifecycles
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 240s npm run operator:verify 2>&1 | tee /tmp/universal-revenue-test.log

      - name: Verify unified startup and fail-closed providers
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          rm -rf "$CYVX_DATA_ROOT"
          CYVX_OPERATOR_PORT=3020 CYVX_MISSION_PORT=3030 npm run operator > /tmp/universal-revenue.log 2>&1 &
          PID=$!
          cleanup() { kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; }
          trap cleanup EXIT
          for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3020/healthz >/tmp/universal-revenue-health.json; then
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          node -e 'const x=require("/tmp/universal-revenue-health.json");if(!x.ok||!x.universal||!x.revenue||!x.revenue.database||!x.universal.legacy_company_compatibility)process.exit(1)'
          curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3020/operator | grep -q "CYVX Universal Operator"
          curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3020/revenue | grep -q "Venture Revenue Engine"
          curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3020/api/v2/operator/entity-types | grep -q '"production"'
          curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3020/api/v3/revenue/health | grep -q '"cyvx-venture-revenue-engine"'
          node - <<'NODE'
          const x = require('/tmp/universal-revenue-health.json');
          if (x.revenue.providers.email.configured) throw new Error('CI unexpectedly has email credentials');
          if (x.revenue.providers.stripe.configured) throw new Error('CI unexpectedly has Stripe credentials');
          if (x.revenue.verified_revenue_cents !== 0) throw new Error('CI must not manufacture revenue');
          NODE

      - name: Upload diagnostic evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: universal-revenue-operator-verification
          path: |
            /tmp/v7-source-validation.log
            /tmp/universal-revenue-test.log
            /tmp/universal-revenue.log
            /tmp/universal-revenue-health.json
            /tmp/cyvx-universal-revenue-ci/logs/*.jsonl*
            /tmp/cyvx-universal-revenue-ci/platform-state.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14

  pull_request:
    paths:

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: apps/cyvx-flash-relay
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: foundry-rs/foundry-toolchain@v1
        with:
          version: stable

        run: |
          cp .env.example .env
          sed -i 's|^READ_RPC_UPSTREAM=.*|READ_RPC_UPSTREAM=https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com|' .env
          chmod 600 .env
      - name: Install forge-std

      - name: Validate Python runtime

          python3 -m py_compile ops/*.py dashboard/server.py

      - name: Normalize Solidity formatting
        run: forge fmt
      - name: Compile contracts
        run: forge build --sizes
      - name: Test profitable settlement
        run: forge test --match-test testProfitableRouteRepaysLoanAndStoresProfit -vvvv
      - name: Test atomic unprofitable revert
        run: forge test --match-test testUnprofitableRouteRevertsAtomically -vvvv
      - name: Test treasury isolation
        run: forge test --match-test testTreasuryCannotMaskLosingTrade -vvvv
      - name: Test operator authorization

      - name: Test pause circuit breaker

name: CYVX v7 Production

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions: write-all

concurrency:
  group: cyvx-v7-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Verify Node ${{ matrix.node }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node: [22, 24]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run verify

  production-loop:
    name: Prove autonomous production loop
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: verify
    env:
      PORT: 3300
      CYVX_PUBLIC_PORT: 3300
      CYVX_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_PORT: 3301
      CYVX_INTERNAL_PORT: 3302
      CYVX_SPARK_INTERNAL_PORT: 3303
      CYVX_CONTROL_PORT: 3304
      CYVX_DATA_ROOT: /tmp/cyvx-v7
      CYVX_PLATFORM_STATE: /tmp/cyvx-v7/platform.json
      CYVX_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_STORE: /tmp/cyvx-v7/webhooks.json
      CYVX_GITHUB_AUTH_STORE: /tmp/cyvx-v7/auth.json
      SPARK_STATE_FILE: /tmp/cyvx-v7/spark.json
      SPARK_ARTIFACT_ROOT: /tmp/cyvx-v7/worlds
      CYVX_AUTONOMY: 1
      CYVX_AUTONOMY_INTERVAL_MS: 500
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Start CYVX v7
        run: |
          npm start > /tmp/cyvx-v7.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > /tmp/cyvx-v7.pid
          for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
            if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3300/readyz >/dev/null && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3304/readyz >/dev/null; then exit 0; fi
            sleep 1
          done
          cat /tmp/cyvx-v7.log
          exit 1
      - name: Create and approve a Spark
        run: |
          CREATED="$(curl -fsS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3300/api/v1/sparks \
            -H 'content-type: application/json' \
            -H 'idempotency-key: ci-v7-spark' \
            -d '{"owner_id":"ci-founder","intention":"Launch an owned service World that captures qualified leads","world":{"name":"CI V7 World","offer_name":"Production Audit","offer_description":"A verified production systems audit","price_cents":150000}}')"
          printf '%s' "$CREATED" > /tmp/created.json
          SPARK_ID="$(node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("/tmp/created.json","utf8")).data.spark.id')"
          WORLD_ID="$(node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("/tmp/created.json","utf8")).data.world.id')"
          echo "$SPARK_ID" > /tmp/spark-id
          echo "$WORLD_ID" > /tmp/world-id
          curl -fsS -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:3300/api/v1/sparks/$SPARK_ID/approval" \
            -H 'content-type: application/json' \
            -d '{"owner_id":"ci-founder","decision":"approved","reason":"CI approved bounded production execution"}'
      - name: Verify autonomous execution and proof
        run: |
          SPARK_ID="$(cat /tmp/spark-id)"
          for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
            GRAPH="$(curl -fsS -H 'x-spark-owner: ci-founder' "http://127.0.0.1:3300/api/public/sparks/$SPARK_ID")"
            STATUS="$(printf '%s' "$GRAPH" | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8")).data.world.status')"
            if [ "$STATUS" = "operational" ]; then printf '%s' "$GRAPH" > /tmp/graph.json; break; fi
            sleep 1
          done
          node -e 'const g=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("/tmp/graph.json","utf8")).data;if(g.world.status!=="operational"||g.evidence.length<6)process.exit(1)'
      - name: Capture intent and inspect control plane
        run: |
          WORLD_ID="$(cat /tmp/world-id)"
          curl -fsS -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:3300/api/v1/worlds/$WORLD_ID/leads" \
            -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'idempotency-key: ci-v7-lead' \
            -d '{"name":"CI Buyer","email":"buyer@example.com","message":"Requesting the production audit"}'
          curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3300/api/public/worlds | grep 'CI V7 World'

          node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8"));if(!p.ok)process.exit(4)' "$PROOF_DIR/verification.json"

          };
          fs.writeFileSync(`artifacts/topology/${process.env.REQUEST_ID}/proof.json`, `${JSON.stringify(document, null, 2)}\n`);
          NODE

          rm -f "$REQUEST_PATH"
          git status --short > "$PROOF_DIR/git-status.txt"
          test -s "$PROOF_DIR/git-status.txt"
          echo "request_id=$REQUEST_ID" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "run_id=$RUN_ID" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Upload migration and rollback evidence
        if: always() && steps.pr.outputs.execute == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4

jobs:

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: github/codeql-action/init@v4
        with:
          languages: javascript-typescript
          build-mode: none
      - uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v4
        with:
          category: /language:javascript-typescript

  dependency-audit:
    name: Runtime dependency audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high

  dependency-review:
    name: Pull request dependency review
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - name: Detect dependency graph availability
        id: dependency-graph
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          status="$(curl --silent --show-error --output /tmp/cyvx-sbom.json --write-out '%{http_code}' \
            --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
            --header 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/dependency-graph/sbom")"
          if [ "$status" = "200" ]; then
            echo "available=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "available=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Dependency graph unavailable (HTTP $status); using locked-install and audit fallback."
          fi
      - uses: actions/dependency-review-action@v5
        if: steps.dependency-graph.outputs.available == 'true'
        with:
          fail-on-severity: high
          fail-on-scopes: runtime
      - name: Deterministic dependency fallback
        if: steps.dependency-graph.outputs.available != 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git diff --check "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}...${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}" -- package.json package-lock.json
          npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
          npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
